name: talentflow
description: TalentFlow: AI-powered applicant screening and pipeline system (Trader Joe's, COMP019)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
